7 unchanged paragraphs, under In short {#in-short}

• **Real usage, cross-referenced:** PrompTugal.news, the Web Summit team, the factory's sites, five apps, VoiceDebriefVoiceDebrief, OmKneeHealth and this newsroom each use the layers below.

6 unchanged paragraphs, under Why now {#why}, The foundations {#foundations}

• **[SGit](https://sgit.ai/):** git for encrypted vaults. A vault is a unit of work, data, app, history and sources, versioned and handed over with a single read key; lanes in a vault are how our agents message each other with a record. It sits under almost everything here.here, and its two public examples are the summit and the health scenario with OmKneeHealth.

16 unchanged paragraphs, under The standard: Agent Behaviour Policies {#abp}, RiskMandate, and what it was missing {#riskmandate}, AgentiCCells: the first step {#agenticcells}…

• **OmKneeHealth:** [Chinmay Gupte](https://www.chinmaygupte.com), a consultant knee surgeon in London, is building [OmKneeHealth](https://www.omkneehealth.com), a clinically led platform for knee health, for patients and clinicians he already knows ([the expert founders](../../the-expert-founders.md)). I have been helping him. Health-related projects use vaults, and his is the public scenario: data that has to stay private, and still be handed over to the right person ([where to invest in sgit](../../where-to-invest-in-sgit.md)).
